recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-12416 unless a future broad UCUM terminology refresh deliberately changes the Common UCUM Units source.
issue_request: FHIR-12416 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request against FHIR-core-ValueSet asking that the UCUM common codes dL and dg display as deciliter and decigram rather than decaliter and decagram.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit 5221956b4d, svn revision 10452, titled "#12416 - fix UCUM display errors". That commit changed source/valueset/valueset-ucum-common.xml from decagram/decaliter to decigram/deciliter, matching the Jira comments saying the typo was fixed.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists valueset=ValueSet as an active resource and source/valueset/list-ValueSet-examples.xml references ValueSet/ucum-common, so the inspected source is in build scope. Later reconciled issues FHIR-33030 and FHIR-36012 touched the same value set for display normalization and UCUM comment cleanup, but neither reversed this dL/dg correction. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The active source already contains the requested dL/deciliter and dg/decigram displays, and no active source occurrence of the incorrect decagram/decaliter displays for those concepts was found.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive Vocab correction normalized Common UCUM Units displays and is already represented on the combined branch; it did not reverse the dL/dg typo fix.
Later Published/Persuasive cleanup removed UCUM comments and deduplicated common units and is already represented on the combined branch; it did not reverse the dL/dg typo fix.
